Name: Kish, Son of Abiel
Summary: Kish, son of Abiel, was a mighty man of power from Benjamin. His lost donkeys sent Saul searching, and that search led Saul to Samuel and to the throne.
KeyStory: Kish's lost donkeys set in motion the day his son was anointed king.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Ner, Son of Abiel; Abiel
LifeLesson: God often steers a life through the most ordinary errand.
